name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 24 times in 11 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-05-26, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.47 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
